say:1:1130937001:1.text: We have to go to another settlement to ask for help.
say:1:1130937001:1.source_cn: 我们要去其他聚落求援。

say:2:1130937002:1.text: Lots of strange things have been happening lately. Wild animals have been constantly attacking our clan, and a humongous, black monster appeared just two days ago! We've never seen anything like it before!
say:2:1130937002:1.source_cn: 最近发生了好多怪事，老是有发狂的动物闯进我们部落，这两...

choice_prompt:3:1130937002.text: Lots of strange things have been happening lately. Wild animals have been constantly attacking our clan, and a humongous, black monster appeared just two days ago! We've never seen anything like it before!
choice_prompt:3:1130937002.source_cn: 最近发生了好多怪事，老是有发狂的动物闯进我们部落，这两天还出现了一种巨大的、黑色的怪物！以前见都没见过！

say:4:1130937003:1.text: Not well, no... I've only seen it once, and it was from a distance.
say:4:1130937003:1.source_cn: 该怎么说呢……我只远远地见过它一次。

say:5:1130937004:1.text: It was enormous in size, and its body was pitch-black. It looked like a giant compared to any beast I've ever seen!
say:5:1130937004:1.source_cn: 它通体漆黑，体型庞大，在它面前，部落里最大的房子也不堪一击！

say:6:1130937005:1.text: But as far as I could tell, it had neither hide nor fur. In fact, it appeared to be made entirely of smoke...
say:6:1130937005:1.source_cn: 不像是野兽，完全没有皮毛，倒很像是有实体的烟雾……

say:7:1130937006:1.text: But I can't sit around chatting! I need to get Akira back on her feet! Otherwise, there's no telling how long it'll take for us to find help!
say:7:1130937006:1.source_cn: 哎呀，不能再聊了！我得催奥奎拉起来赶路了，不然都不知道...
